The '''''Assertor''''' was the lead ship of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Assertor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Assertor''-class Star Dreadnoughts]].

==History==
The ''Assertor'' and her sister ship [[Wrath (Assertor-class)/Legends|''Wrath'']] were the first two ''Assertor''-class dreadnoughts built, and were both completed and launched just prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] used her as a sector command and control ship, and she often traveled in task groups flanked by [[Bellator-class dreadnought/Legends|''Bellator'']] and ''Mandator''-class dreadnoughts when undergoing fleet maneuvers.<ref name="Lead by Example" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Assertor''-class Star Dreadnought originated as a [[fanon]] design by [[Ansel Hsiao]], who envisioned a 15 kilometer long warship with power generation approximately equivalent to 400 [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="AHPSD1">{{WebCite|url=http://bbs.stardestroyer.net/viewtopic.php?p=3242676#p3242676|text=Something big|author=fractalsponge1|date=2010-10-02|work=[https://bbs.stardestroyer.net/index.php StarDestroyer.Net BBS]|archivedate=20200615214309}}</ref> The design [[List of fanon elements in continuity|entered continuity]] when it appeared in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', on which Ansel worked as an illustrator. [[Jason Fry]], author of ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'', confirmed in his blog that the class name and specifications have been officially recorded by [[Lucas Licensing]].<ref name="endnotes" /> The ''Assertor'' was first identified as the lead ship of her class in ''[[Lead by Example]]'', a sourcebook for the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]] that was released on February 4, [[2016]].<ref name="Lead by Example" />
